name: AltoRank
description: Hosted MCP server for AltoRank, open-source SEO content software: site readiness audits, JSON-LD proposals, Google Search Console, keyword research, and SEO drafts written into a person's review queue. Streamable HTTP at https://app.altorank.co/api/mcp with AltoRank account OAuth. No tool approves or publishes a draft. Self-hostable (AGPL-3.0).
